'''Malak Memorial Research Base''' was a research base within [[Camp Conquest]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Named for [[Darth Malak]], the base was operated by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and was the primary research facility for [[Project Nebula]].
